highlights.reason_zh: 版本化 Skills、长任务压缩和混合检索一起进入稳定版，直接影响自托管 agent 工作流。
highlights.reason_en: Versioned Skills, long-run compaction and hybrid retrieval reach stable together, directly affecting self-hosted agent workflows.

highlights.reason_zh: 后台任务、执行 receipt 和多 agent session 改变 coding agent 的恢复与重复执行风险。
highlights.reason_en: Background jobs, execution receipts and multi-agent sessions change coding-agent recovery and duplicate-execution risk.

highlights.reason_zh: MCP 发现、执行授权和检索片段护栏被放进同一 gateway 回归面。
highlights.reason_en: MCP discovery, execution authorization and retrieved-chunk guardrails now share one gateway regression surface.

highlights.reason_zh: Skill 搜索、MCP Apps 与可恢复备份一起影响本地 agent 的权限和运维边界。
highlights.reason_en: Skill search, MCP Apps and recoverable backups jointly affect local-agent permission and operations boundaries.

highlights.reason_zh: 开放权重的 OCR、grounding 与图表解析提供了可在自有文档上直接复核的工程候选。
highlights.reason_en: Open-weight OCR, grounding and chart parsing provide an engineering candidate that can be tested directly on local documents.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；本轮新增 6 条事件，更新 3 条既有事件，完成 10 项到期复核与 gap review。召回审计补录 Talorys 与 Iris-3B；四条补录的时间与独立验证限制已标明。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and reviewed. The run added six events, updated three existing events, completed ten due reviews and ran the gap review. Recall audit recovered Talorys and Iris-3B; time and independent-validation limits are recorded for all four late discoveries.
